brief:
The high turnout of Palestinian voters in Israel has triggered significant backlash, according to Al Jazeera English. Palestinian citizens of Israel, who make up roughly 21 percent of the population, participated at elevated rates in recent voting.

The response from Israeli political circles has intensified debates over Palestinian political participation and representation within the state. Questions about voting rights, citizenship, and the institutional treatment of Palestinian Israelis now dominate discussion of the country's political future.
dek: The backlash against the high Palestinian turnout reveals much about the state of Israeli democracy and its future.
title: Palestinian Voter Turnout Sparks Israeli Political Backlash
